# CANDIDATE: GAP_FADE_VWAP_RETEST_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

After an upward gap, price often reverts to fill the gap by testing VWAP as resistance, offering a short opportunity. The edge exists because gap-up opens frequently attract early buying that exhausts, allowing mean-reversion to VWAP, especially when intraday momentum shows rejection at VWAP with overbought RSI and above-average volume.

## Mechanism

Entry: If today's open > prior close + 0.4% (gap up) AND open > VWAP at open, then wait for a bar that closes below VWAP with its high ≤ VWAP (rejection), RSI(14) > 55 (overbought), and volume > average volume (20-bar). Enter short at the bar's close. Exit: Initial stop at the high of the entry bar (chart‑stop), target 1.5R. After reaching 1R, trail stop at 20% of ATR from the highest high. Regime filter: only consider when VIX > 18 (elevated volatility) and within the first two hours of trade (09:30‑11:30 ET); skip when VIX < 12.
